settings.doc: Keep onnxruntime's CPU memory arena (off: board RSS tracks live use).
settings.label: Search memory reuse
settings.help: Keep memory the search model used, for a little more speed. Off keeps the board's memory use lower.

settings.doc: fastembed model used for dense search.
settings.label: Search model
settings.help: The model that turns text into search vectors. Changing it rebuilds the search index.

settings.doc: onnxruntime intra-op threads of the embedding model.
settings.label: Search indexing threads
settings.help: CPU threads used to index text for search. More is faster but takes CPU from everything else.

settings.doc: Force the embedder: fastembed, ollama or none; unset = fastembed, then ollama, then none.
settings.label: Search engine
settings.help: How the board finds related records: fastembed (built in), ollama (a local Ollama server) or none (words only). Leave empty to pick automatically.

settings.doc: Ollama base URL for the ollama embedder.
settings.label: Ollama address
settings.help: Where Ollama runs, when search uses Ollama.

settings.doc: Drop ranked records scoring below this fraction of the top hit (0 disables).
settings.label: Search relevance cut-off
settings.help: Results scoring below this share of the best match are dropped. 0 keeps everything.

settings.doc: `heronry start` also starts the code server (it is opt-in: `heronry start code`).
settings.label: Start VS Code in the browser with Heronry
settings.help: Start the code server whenever Heronry starts. Off: start it yourself from Admin → Services or the tray.

settings.doc: code-server executable (or its entry .js); default `code-server` on PATH.
settings.label: code-server program
settings.help: Where code-server is installed, if it is not on your PATH. Leave empty to find it on the PATH.

settings.doc: code-server port: the loopback guard `heronry start code` puts in front of code-server holds it.
settings.label: VS Code in the browser port
settings.help: The port of the browser VS Code the board links to. Match it to where you run code-server.

settings.doc: Plane API key.
settings.label: Plane API key
settings.help: The key the board uses to write to Plane. Kept private, never shown again.

settings.doc: Plane project id.
settings.label: Plane project
settings.help: The Plane project tickets are mirrored into.

settings.doc: JSON map of ticket status to Plane state; unset = identity map.
settings.label: Plane status map
settings.help: Which Plane state each ticket status becomes, as JSON. Leave empty to use the same names.

settings.doc: Plane base URL; set turns on the Plane mirror and webhook.
settings.label: Plane address
settings.help: Your Plane server. Setting it turns on the Plane mirror; Admin → Integrations sets this for you.

settings.doc: HMAC secret the Plane webhook signature is checked against; empty = unchecked.
settings.label: Plane webhook secret
settings.help: The secret Plane signs its webhook calls with, so the board can trust them.

settings.doc: Plane workspace slug.
settings.label: Plane workspace
settings.help: The Plane workspace tickets are mirrored into.

settings.doc: Extra allowed Slack webhook hosts (comma-separated) besides hooks.slack.com.
settings.label: Extra Slack webhook hosts
settings.help: Other hosts besides hooks.slack.com that Slack notifications may be sent to.

settings.doc: 'single-host' enables MCP uploads over HTTP from local seats; anything else disables them.
settings.label: Agent file uploads
settings.help: single-host lets agents on this computer attach files to the board; off turns uploads off.

settings.doc: Absolute path of the HTTP upload policy JSON (workspace root and per-seat roots).
settings.label: Upload rules file
settings.help: A JSON file that says which folders agents may upload from.

settings.doc: Operator ACL JSON mapping participants to the provider usage they may see; unset = none.
settings.label: Usage access rules
settings.help: A JSON file that says who may see which provider's usage and quota.

settings.doc: Byte cap of the bounded context() snapshot (floor 4000).
settings.label: Agent briefing size
settings.help: The most an agent's starting briefing may hold. Larger gives agents more detail but uses more of their context.

settings.doc: Byte cap of one context_delta page (floor 4000).
settings.label: Agent update size
settings.help: The most one batch of updates to an agent may hold.

settings.doc: Byte cap of one feed_driver output line (floor 600).
settings.label: Agent wake line size
settings.help: The most one wake-up line sent to an agent may hold.

settings.doc: The board's uvicorn log level.
settings.label: Board log detail
settings.help: How much the board's web server writes to its log. Use debug only while chasing a problem.

settings.doc: Log every request's route template, status, ms and bytes to <logs>/timing.jsonl (S22 profiling).
settings.label: Log request timings
settings.help: Write how long every board request takes to a log file, to find what makes the app slow.

settings.doc: Seconds one MCP tool call may take before it is answered as still running.
settings.label: Agent tool time limit
settings.help: How long one agent request to the board may run before the agent is told it is still running.

settings.doc: Byte cap of one list/query tool page (ticket_query, doc_query, participants, ...; floor 2000).
settings.label: Agent list page size
settings.help: The most one list an agent asks for may hold before it is split into pages.

settings.doc: Which renderer owns /ui: folio (the SPA; legacy kept at /ui-legacy) or legacy (no SPA).
settings.label: Web app style
settings.help: Which web app the board serves: folio is the current app, legacy the old one.

settings.doc: Hourly sweep of staged uploads nobody finalised (the startup sweep always runs).
settings.label: Clean up abandoned uploads
settings.help: Every hour, delete files that were uploaded but never attached to anything.

settings.doc: uvicorn access log for the broker (floods: rx inbox polls every ~2 s).
settings.label: Broker request log
settings.help: Log every request to the message broker. Very noisy; only for troubleshooting.

settings.doc: Seconds uvicorn waits for open SSE streams at shutdown before cancelling them.
settings.label: Broker stop wait
settings.help: How long the message broker waits for open connections when it stops.

settings.doc: Seconds a lane ticket waits before it sorts as top priority (anti-starvation).
settings.label: Model queue fairness
settings.help: An agent waiting this long in the model queue goes to the front, so nobody waits forever.

settings.doc: Seconds an untouched lane queue ticket lives before a waiter removes it as dead.
settings.label: Model queue cleanup
settings.help: A waiting spot in the model queue untouched this long is removed.

settings.doc: Seconds a lane holder may go without touching its lock before it is treated as dead.
settings.label: Model queue lock timeout
settings.help: An agent holding its turn in the model queue this long without activity is treated as gone.

settings.doc: Structured log level.
settings.label: Log detail
settings.help: How much the services write to their logs. Use debug only while chasing a problem; it makes logs much bigger.

settings.doc: Days of structured logs kept.
settings.label: Keep logs for
settings.help: How many days of log files are kept before old ones are deleted. Raise it if you need to look further back when something goes wrong.

settings.doc: uvicorn access log for the pool (off: the rx polls flood it).
settings.label: Seat pool request log
settings.help: Log every request to the seat pool. Very noisy; only for troubleshooting.

settings.doc: Per-probe timeout of the pool doctor's HTTP checks.
settings.label: Health check timeout
settings.help: How long each health check waits for an answer.

settings.doc: Hard ceiling on live shell processes (active+starting+parked+resuming); default 2x the total cap.
settings.label: Most agents alive
settings.help: How many agent processes may exist, sleeping ones included. Empty means twice the total. Services → Capacity changes it live; this is the value the pool starts with.

settings.doc: Cap on concurrent planner shells.
settings.label: Most planner agents
settings.help: How many planning agents may run at once. Services → Capacity changes it live; this is the value the pool starts with.

settings.doc: Cap on concurrent throughput shells of every role.
settings.label: Most agents in total
settings.help: How many agents may work at once, all roles together. Services → Capacity changes it live; this is the value the pool starts with.

settings.doc: Cap on concurrent worker shells.
settings.label: Most builder agents
settings.help: How many building agents may run at once. Services → Capacity changes it live; this is the value the pool starts with.

settings.doc: A parked shell idle this long is resumed for a reconcile tick; 0 disables.
settings.label: Sleeping agent check-in
settings.help: A sleeping agent is woken this often to catch up on its work. 0 turns it off.

settings.doc: Auto-resume deadline of a paused (suspended) shell.
settings.label: Longest pause
settings.help: A paused agent resumes on its own after this long.

settings.doc: How long a spawn waits for the shell to become ready.
settings.label: Agent start timeout
settings.help: How long to wait for a new agent to be ready. Raise it on a slow machine.

settings.doc: Run the parked-handle resume watchdog.
settings.label: Wake sleeping agents
settings.help: Watch for messages to sleeping agents and wake them.

settings.doc: Resume watchdog poll cadence.
settings.label: Sleeping agent check interval
settings.help: How often sleeping agents are checked for new messages.

settings.doc: uvicorn graceful-shutdown bound, so an open panel long-poll cannot freeze a stop.
settings.label: Seat pool stop wait
settings.help: How long the seat pool waits for open connections when it stops.

settings.doc: Age after which a spawn reservation still 'starting' counts as abandoned.
settings.label: Stuck start cleanup
settings.help: An agent still starting after this long is treated as failed.

settings.doc: Delay between typing a prompt into a shell and pressing Enter.
settings.label: Typing delay
settings.help: Pause between typing a message into an agent and pressing Enter.

settings.doc: Hard bound on one resumed turn's wall clock; 0 disables.
settings.label: Longest agent turn
settings.help: The longest one agent turn may run before it is stopped. 0 means no limit.

settings.doc: Longest a console wake waits for the operator to stop typing before deferring.
settings.label: Wait while you type
settings.help: How long a wake-up waits while you are typing in an agent's terminal.

settings.doc: Auto-recorded decisions allowed per epic.
settings.label: Automatic decisions per epic
settings.help: How many decisions the board may record on its own for one epic.

settings.doc: Run the RSI retrieval-regression sweep in the board (re-read every loop).
settings.label: Search quality check
settings.help: Run a background check that warns when search results get worse.

settings.doc: Seconds between RSI sweep ticks.
settings.label: Search check interval
settings.help: Time between search quality checks.

settings.doc: Free RAM (MB) below which an RSI tick holds instead of running.
settings.label: Search check memory floor
settings.help: The search quality check waits while free memory is below this.

settings.doc: Seconds the RSI CLI waits for the dense index to warm.
settings.label: Search check warm-up
settings.help: How long the search check waits for the search index to load.

settings.doc: Board bind host; unset = loopback, or the public-mode default.
settings.label: Board listens on
settings.help: Which network address the board accepts connections on. Leave empty to allow only this computer; Remote access sets it for you.

settings.doc: Board HTTP port.
settings.label: Board port
settings.help: The port the board (the web app) listens on. Change it only if another program already uses it.

settings.doc: Broker bind host.
settings.label: Message broker address
settings.help: Network address of the message broker that wakes agents. Leave it on this computer (127.0.0.1).

settings.doc: Broker port.
settings.label: Message broker port
settings.help: Port of the message broker that wakes agents. Change it only if another program already uses it.

settings.doc: MCP proxy bind host.
settings.label: Agent tools address
settings.help: Network address of the service agents use to reach the board. Leave it on this computer (127.0.0.1).

settings.doc: MCP proxy port.
settings.label: Agent tools port
settings.help: Port of the service agents use to reach the board. Change it only if another program already uses it.

settings.doc: stdio runs the MCP server per shell over stdio; anything else serves shared streamable-http.
settings.label: Agent tools connection
settings.help: How agents connect to the board: shared (one service for all agents) or stdio (one per agent, for troubleshooting).

settings.doc: Seat pool bind host.
settings.label: Seat pool address
settings.help: Network address of the seat pool that starts agents. Leave it on this computer (127.0.0.1).

settings.doc: Phoenix (tracing) URL the pool doctor probes.
settings.label: Phoenix tracing address
settings.help: Where Phoenix tracing runs, if you use it.

settings.doc: Seat pool port.
settings.label: Seat pool port
settings.help: Port of the seat pool that starts agents. Change it only if another program already uses it.

settings.doc: Tags a minted auth key applies to the new device (an OAuth-minted key must carry tags).
settings.label: Tailscale key tags
settings.help: Tags a colleague's machine gets when it joins with a minted key.

settings.doc: Tailscale OAuth client id (scope auth_keys) that mints teammates' auth keys; empty = feature off.
settings.label: Tailscale OAuth client id
settings.help: Lets you mint Tailscale keys so a colleague's machine can join your tailnet. Create the client in Tailscale with the auth_keys scope.

settings.doc: Tailscale OAuth client secret for the client above.
settings.label: Tailscale OAuth client secret
settings.help: The secret of the Tailscale OAuth client above. Kept private, never shown again.

settings.doc: Tailnet the auth keys are minted in; '-' = the OAuth client's own tailnet.
settings.label: Tailnet
settings.help: The tailnet new keys are made in. Leave '-' for the OAuth client's own tailnet.

settings.doc: codex executable; default `codex` on PATH.
settings.label: Codex program
settings.help: Where the Codex CLI is installed. Set it only if Codex is not found on your PATH.

settings.doc: Reasoning effort of a codex seat (low|medium|high).
settings.label: Codex thinking effort
settings.help: How hard a Codex agent thinks before answering. Higher is slower and uses more of your quota.

settings.doc: Default model of a codex seat.
settings.label: Codex model
settings.help: The model a Codex agent uses unless the models catalog picks another one.

settings.doc: Overrides the per-role codex sandbox.
settings.label: Codex file access
settings.help: What a Codex agent may touch on disk. Leave empty to use each role's own setting.

settings.doc: Pi executable or <pi-coding-agent>/dist/cli.js; default `pi` on PATH.
settings.label: Pi program
settings.help: Where the Pi agent program is installed. Set it only if Pi is not found on your PATH.

settings.doc: Dir of the npm-installed Pi harness (node_modules inside).
settings.label: Pi install folder
settings.help: The folder where Pi was installed with npm. Set it only if Pi's files are not found.

settings.doc: Optional override; otherwise the catalog supplies the Pi provider/model.
settings.label: Pi model
settings.help: The model a Pi agent uses. Leave empty to use the models catalog.

settings.doc: JSON map of Pi provider ids to API key and optional base URL; kept in secret settings.
settings.label: Pi provider keys
settings.help: API keys for the model providers Pi agents use. Kept in a private file, never shown again.

settings.doc: Thinking level of a Pi seat.
settings.label: Pi thinking effort
settings.help: How hard a Pi agent thinks before answering. Higher is slower and costs more.

settings.doc: claude executable for pool shells; default `claude` on PATH (npm shim resolved to the exe).
settings.label: Claude Code program
settings.help: Where Claude Code is installed. Set it only if claude is not found on your PATH.

settings.doc: Dir or file holding the full claude.exe to repair an npm stub from.
settings.label: Claude Code repair copy
settings.help: A folder with a full Claude Code program, used to repair a broken npm install.

settings.doc: Route spawns whose model is a codex seat (or codex/<id>) to the codex backend.
settings.label: Pick Codex by model
settings.help: Run an agent on Codex whenever its model is a Codex model.

settings.doc: Roles always routed to the codex app-server backend.
settings.label: Roles on Codex
settings.help: Roles that always run as Codex agents.

settings.doc: Roles always routed to the Pi backend.
settings.label: Roles on Pi
settings.help: Roles that always run as Pi agents.

settings.doc: Python that runs the Pi/codex seat runner; default the agent home's .venv python.
settings.label: Python for Pi and Codex agents
settings.help: The Python that runs Pi and Codex agents. Leave empty for the app's own.

settings.doc: Secret-looking env names still passed through to spawned shells (comma list).
settings.label: Pass-through secrets
settings.help: Names of secret-looking environment variables agents may still see, comma separated.

settings.doc: Default spawn mode when neither the request nor the panel sets one (monitor|headless).
settings.label: How agents run
settings.help: monitor opens each agent in a terminal you can watch; headless runs agents in the background.

settings.doc: Selected seat harnesses (claude, codex, pi; at least one of claude/codex), set by `heronry init`.
settings.label: Agent programs in use
settings.help: Which agent programs this install uses: claude, codex and pi. At least one of claude or codex.

settings.doc: Shell the codex seat's Monitor tool runs under; default bash (Git Bash on Windows).
settings.label: Codex watch shell
settings.help: The shell a Codex agent uses to watch for events. Leave empty for bash.

settings.doc: codex seat Monitor tool variant.
settings.label: Codex watch style
settings.help: How a Codex agent's watch tool behaves: persistent keeps watching, expiry stops after a time limit.

settings.doc: npm registry Admin → Integrations asks for the latest claude/codex/pi versions.
settings.label: npm registry
settings.help: Where the app checks for new versions of claude, codex and pi. Change it only if you use a private npm mirror.

settings.doc: Seats run without permission prompts (claude --dangerously-skip-permissions, codex danger-full-access).
settings.label: Agents act without asking
settings.help: Agents run commands and edit files without stopping for a yes or no. Turn it off if you want to approve each action yourself.

settings.doc: bash for scripts and the codex Monitor tool; default Git's bash next to git (Windows) or `bash` on PATH.
settings.label: Bash program
settings.help: Which bash runs scripts. Set it only if the default (Git Bash on Windows) is missing or wrong.

settings.doc: git executable; default `git` on PATH. On Windows it also locates Git's bash.
settings.label: Git program
settings.help: Where Git is installed. Set it only if Git is not found on your PATH.

settings.doc: node executable (Pi's cli.js, the codex seat's WebSocket monitor); default `node` on PATH.
settings.label: Node.js program
settings.help: Where Node.js is installed. Set it only if Node.js is not found on your PATH.

settings.doc: 1: never ask GitHub for a newer release (the daily and on-start check).
settings.label: Don't check for updates
settings.help: Stop asking GitHub once a day whether a newer Heronry release exists.

settings.doc: GitHub owner/repo whose latest release `heronry update` installs.
settings.label: Update source
settings.help: The GitHub repository updates come from. Change it only if you run your own build.
